description: Header file defining the template class StorageBlock for managing disk cache storage blocks, including methods for loading, storing, and managing data buffers.

classes.name: StorageBlock
classes.description: Template class managing a storage block in disk cache, with methods for data access, load/store operations, and hash verification.

methods.name: StorageBlock
methods.description: Constructor initializing a storage block with a file and address.

methods.name: ~StorageBlock
methods.description: Destructor that stores data if modified and deletes data buffer.

methods.name: CopyFrom
methods.description: Copies data and state from another StorageBlock instance.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns size of the storage block.

methods.name: offset
methods.description: Returns byte offset of the block.

methods.name: LazyInit
methods.description: Initializes the storage block lazily with a file and address.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns pointer to data, allocating if necessary.

methods.name: own_data
methods.description: Returns whether the data buffer is owned.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Returns the address of the storage block.
